name: Oubliette
author: Erin Carter
description: A square masonry shaft seen straight down through a dungeon grate, falling to a black square focus, off-centre by default and movable. Running-bond stone courses are born at the edge and shrink course by course into the dark focus, mortar lines faintly aglow, the overhead grate fixed while the walls pour past it.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the stone courses fall away below the grate.

params.label: Course density
params.effect: Stone courses per scale octave; higher reads as smaller bricks.

params.label: Mortar glow
params.effect: Brightness of the mortar lines between bricks.

params.label: Grate
params.effect: Visibility of the fixed overhead grate silhouette; 0 removes it for an open shaft.

params.label: Focal X
params.effect: Horizontal offset of the shaft's dark focus — off-centre by default for an asymmetric, oblique descent.

params.label: Focal Y
params.effect: Vertical offset of the shaft's focus out of dead-centre.

params.label: Mouse parallax
params.effect: How far the near courses slide toward the pointer for a depth look-around (the deep focus holds; no effect on the static poster).
